verses.original: Καί τινες κατελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐδίδασκον τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι Ἐὰν μὴ περιτμηθῆτε τῷ ἔθει τῷ Μωϋσέως οὐ δύνασθε σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Kai tines katelthontes apo tēs Ioudaias edidaskon tous adelphous hoti Ean mē peritmēthēte tō ethei tō Mōuseōs ou dynasthe sōthēnai
verses.literal: Then some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers Unless . . . you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses you cannot be saved
verses.literalPt: Alguns homens, descendo da Judeia, ensinavam aos irmãos: Se não vos circuncidardes segundo o rito de Moisés, não podeis ser salvos.

verses.original: γενομένης δὲ στάσεως καὶ ζητήσεως οὐκ ὀλίγης τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρνάβᾳ πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἔταξαν ἀναβαίνειν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρνάβαν καί τινας ἄλλους ἐξ αὐτῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ πρεσβυτέρους εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ περὶ τοῦ ζητήματος τούτου
verses.transliteration: genomenēs de staseōs kai zētēseōs ouk oligēs tō Paulō kai tō Barnaba pros autous etaxan anabainein Paulon kai Barnaban kai tinas allous ex autōn pros tous apostolous kai presbyterous eis Ierousalēm peri tou zētēmatos toutou
verses.literal: And after . . . engaging - - these men in sharp debate Paul and Barnabas were appointed along with some other believers . . . to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question
verses.literalPt: Tendo tido Paulo e Barnabé uma grande contenda e discussão com eles, os irmãos resolveram que Paulo, e Barnabé, e alguns outros dentre eles subissem aos apóstolos e presbíteros em Jerusalém acerca dessa questão.

verses.original: Οἱ μὲν οὖν προπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας διήρχοντο τήν τε Φοινίκην καὶ Σαμάρειαν ἐκδιηγούμενοι τὴν ἐπιστροφὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐποίουν χαρὰν μεγάλην πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: Hoi men oun propemphthentes hypo tēs ekklēsias diērchonto tēn te Phoinikēn kai Samareian ekdiēgoumenoi tēn epistrophēn tōn ethnōn kai epoioun charan megalēn pasin tois adelphois
verses.literal: Sent on their way - by the church they passed through - Phoenicia and Samaria recounting the conversion of the Gentiles and bringing great joy to all the brothers
verses.literalPt: Eles, pois, sendo acompanhados até uma parte do caminho pela igreja, passavam pela Fenícia e Samaria, narrando a conversão dos gentios,

verses.original: παραγενόμενοι δὲ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παρεδέχθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας καὶ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἀνήγγειλάν τε ὅσα ὁ Θεὸς ἐποίησεν μετ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: paragenomenoi de eis Hierosolyma paredechthēsan apo tēs ekklēsias kai tōn apostolōn kai tōn presbyterōn anēngeilan te hosa ho Theos epoiēsen met’ autōn
verses.literal: On their arrival in Jerusalem they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders to whom they reported all that God had done through them
verses.literalPt: e davam grande alegria a todos os irmãos. Chegados a Jerusalém, foram bem recebidos pela igreja, pelos apóstolos e pelos presbíteros e referiram tudo o que Deus tinha feito com eles.

verses.original: Ἐξανέστησαν δέ τινες τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς αἱρέσεως τῶν Φαρισαίων πεπιστευκότες λέγοντες ὅτι Δεῖ περιτέμνειν αὐτοὺς παραγγέλλειν τε τηρεῖν τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως
verses.transliteration: Exanestēsan de tines tōn apo tēs haireseōs tōn Pharisaiōn pepisteukotes legontes hoti Dei peritemnein autous parangellein te tērein ton nomon Mōuseōs
verses.literal: But some believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and declared The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses
verses.literalPt: Mas levantaram-se alguns que tinham sido da seita dos fariseus e que haviam crido, dizendo: É necessário circuncidar os gentios e mandar-lhes que observem a Lei de Moisés.

verses.original: Συνήχθησάν τε οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἰδεῖν περὶ τοῦ λόγου τούτου
verses.transliteration: Synēchthēsan te hoi apostoloi kai hoi presbyteroi idein peri tou logou toutou
verses.literal: So the apostles and elders met to look into . . . this matter
verses.literalPt: Reuniram-se, pois, os apóstolos e os presbíteros para tratar dessa questão.

verses.original: Πολλῆς δὲ ζητήσεως γενομένης ἀναστὰς Πέτρος εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἀφ’ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεὸς διὰ τοῦ στόματός μου ἀκοῦσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὸν λόγον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου καὶ πιστεῦσαι
verses.transliteration: Pollēs de zētēseōs genomenēs anastas Petros eipen pros autous Andres adelphoi hymeis epistasthe hoti aph’ hēmerōn archaiōn en hymin exelexato ho Theos dia tou stomatos mou akousai ta ethnē ton logon tou euangeliou kai pisteusai
verses.literal: After much discussion Peter got up and said to them Brothers you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe
verses.literalPt: Havendo uma grande discussão, levantou-se Pedro e disse: Irmãos, vós sabeis que há muito tempo Deus escolheu-me dentre vós, para que da minha boca ouvissem os gentios a palavra do evangelho e cressem.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ καρδιογνώστης Θεὸς ἐμαρτύρησεν αὐτοῖς δοὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον καθὼς καὶ ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai ho kardiognōstēs Theos emartyrēsen autois dous to Pneuma to Hagion kathōs kai hēmin
verses.literal: And God who knows the heart showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them just as He did to us
verses.literalPt: Deus, que conhece os corações, apresentou testemunho a favor deles, dando-lhes o Espírito Santo, como também a nós,

verses.original: καὶ οὐθὲν διέκρινεν μεταξὺ ἡμῶν τε καὶ αὐτῶν τῇ πίστει καθαρίσας τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai outhen diekrinen metaxy hēmōn te kai autōn tē pistei katharisas tas kardias autōn
verses.literal: He made no distinction between us and them for He cleansed their hearts by faith
verses.literalPt: e não fez distinção alguma entre nós e eles, purificando os seus corações pela fé.

verses.original: Νῦν οὖν τί πειράζετε τὸν Θεόν ἐπιθεῖναι ζυγὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τῶν μαθητῶν ὃν οὔτε οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν οὔτε ἡμεῖς ἰσχύσαμεν βαστάσαι
verses.transliteration: Nyn oun ti peirazete ton Theon epitheinai zygon epi ton trachēlon tōn mathētōn hon oute hoi pateres hēmōn oute hēmeis ischysamen bastasai
verses.literal: Now then why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, por que provais a Deus, pondo um jugo sobre a cerviz dos discípulos, o qual nem nossos pais, nem nós podemos suportar?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ πιστεύομεν σωθῆναι καθ’ ὃν τρόπον κἀκεῖνοι
verses.transliteration: alla dia tēs charitos tou Kyriou Iēsou pisteuomen sōthēnai kath’ hon tropon kakeinoi
verses.literal: On the contrary we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved just as they are
verses.literalPt: Mas cremos que pela graça do Senhor Jesus seremos salvos, assim como eles.

verses.original: Ἐσίγησεν δὲ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος καὶ ἤκουον Βαρνάβα καὶ Παύλου ἐξηγουμένων ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δι’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Esigēsen de pan to plēthos kai ēkouon Barnaba kai Paulou exēgoumenōn hosa epoiēsen ho Theos sēmeia kai terata en tois ethnesin di’ autōn
verses.literal: The whole assembly fell silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describing the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them
verses.literalPt: Toda a assembleia calou-se e escutava a Barnabé e a Paulo, que contavam quantos milagres e prodígios Deus fizera entre os gentios por meio deles.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ σιγῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπεκρίθη Ἰάκωβος λέγων Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ἀκούσατέ μου
verses.transliteration: Meta de to sigēsai autous apekrithē Iakōbos legōn Andres adelphoi akousate mou
verses.literal: When they had finished speaking James declared Brothers listen to me
verses.literalPt: Depois de terminarem, Tiago respondeu: Irmãos, ouvi-me.

verses.original: Συμεὼν ἐξηγήσατο καθὼς πρῶτον ὁ Θεὸς ἐπεσκέψατο λαβεῖν ἐξ ἐθνῶν λαὸν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Symeōn exēgēsato kathōs prōton ho Theos epeskepsato labein ex ethnōn laon tō onomati autou
verses.literal: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own
verses.literalPt: Simão acaba de relatar como Deus primeiramente visitou os gentios, para tomar deles um povo para o seu nome.

verses.original: καὶ τούτῳ συμφωνοῦσιν οἱ λόγοι τῶν προφητῶν καθὼς γέγραπται
verses.transliteration: kai toutō symphōnousin hoi logoi tōn prophētōn kathōs gegraptai
verses.literal: The words of the prophets agree with this as it is written
verses.literalPt: Com isso concordam as palavras dos profetas, como está escrito:

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀναστρέψω καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω τὴν σκηνὴν Δαυὶδ τὴν πεπτωκυῖαν καὶ τὰ κατεσκαμμένα αὐτῆς ἀνοικοδομήσω καὶ ἀνορθώσω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta anastrepsō kai anoikodomēsō tēn skēnēn Dauid tēn peptōkuian kai ta kateskammena autēs anoikodomēsō kai anorthōsō autēn
verses.literal: After this I will return and rebuild - the fallen tent of David - Its ruins I will rebuild and I will restore it . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois disto, voltarei e reedificarei o tabernáculo de Davi, que está caído; reedificarei as suas ruínas e tornarei a levantá-lo,

verses.original: ὅπως ἂν ἐκζητήσωσιν οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὸν Κύριον καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐφ’ οὓς ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ’ αὐτούς λέγει Κύριος ποιῶν ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: hopōs an ekzētēsōsin hoi kataloipoi tōn anthrōpōn ton Kyrion kai panta ta ethnē eph’ hous epikeklētai to onoma mou ep’ autous legei Kyrios poiōn tauta
verses.literal: so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord and all the Gentiles who are called by My name - says the Lord who does these things
verses.literalPt: para que o resto dos homens busque ao Senhor, sim, todos os gentios que têm sido chamados pelo meu nome,

verses.original: γνωστὰ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: gnōsta ap’ aiōnos
verses.literal: that have been known for ages
verses.literalPt: diz o Senhor, que faz essas coisas conhecidas desde o princípio do mundo.

verses.original: Διὸ ἐγὼ κρίνω μὴ παρενοχλεῖν τοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐπιστρέφουσιν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Dio egō krinō mē parenochlein tois apo tōn ethnōn epistrephousin epi ton Theon
verses.literal: It is my judgment therefore that we should not cause trouble for - the Gentiles who are turning to God
verses.literalPt: Por isso, eu julgo que não se deve perturbar os gentios que se estão convertendo a Deus,

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐπιστεῖλαι αὐτοῖς τοῦ ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν ἀλισγημάτων τῶν εἰδώλων καὶ τῆς πορνείας καὶ τοῦ πνικτοῦ καὶ τοῦ αἵματος
verses.transliteration: alla episteilai autois tou apechesthai tōn alisgēmatōn tōn eidōlōn kai tēs porneias kai tou pniktou kai tou haimatos
verses.literal: Instead we should write and tell them to abstain from food polluted by idols from sexual immorality from the meat of strangled animals and from blood
verses.literalPt: mas escrever-lhes que se abstenham das viandas oferecidas aos ídolos, da fornicação, dos animais sufocados e do sangue.

verses.original: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ ἐκ γενεῶν ἀρχαίων κατὰ πόλιν τοὺς κηρύσσοντας αὐτὸν ἔχει ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον ἀναγινωσκόμενος
verses.transliteration: Mōusēs gar ek geneōn archaiōn kata polin tous kēryssontas auton echei en tais synagōgais kata pan sabbaton anaginōskomenos
verses.literal: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Pois Moisés, desde tempos antigos, tem, em cada cidade, homens que o pregam nas sinagogas, onde é lido todos os sábados.

verses.original: Τότε ἔδοξε τοῖς ἀποστόλοις καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις σὺν ὅλῃ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐκλεξαμένους ἄνδρας ἐξ αὐτῶν πέμψαι εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν σὺν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ Βαρνάβᾳ Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν καὶ Σιλᾶν ἄνδρας ἡγουμένους ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: Tote edoxe tois apostolois kai tois presbyterois syn holē tē ekklēsia eklexamenous andras ex autōn pempsai eis Antiocheian syn tō Paulō kai Barnaba Ioudan ton kaloumenon Barsabban kai Silan andras hēgoumenous en tois adelphois
verses.literal: Then the apostles and elders with the whole church decided to select men from among them to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas They chose Judas called Barsabbas and Silas two leaders . . . among the brothers
verses.literalPt: Então, pareceu bem aos apóstolos e aos presbíteros com toda a igreja escolher homens dentre eles e enviá-los a Antioquia com Paulo e Barnabé; e escolheram Judas, chamado Barsabás, e Silas, homens principais entre os irmãos,

verses.original: γράψαντες διὰ χειρὸς αὐτῶν Οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἀδελφοὶ Τοῖς κατὰ τὴν Ἀντιόχειαν καὶ Συρίαν καὶ Κιλικίαν ἀδελφοῖς τοῖς ἐξ ἐθνῶν Χαίρειν
verses.transliteration: grapsantes dia cheiros autōn Hoi apostoloi kai hoi presbyteroi adelphoi Tois kata tēn Antiocheian kai Syrian kai Kilikian adelphois tois ex ethnōn Chairein
verses.literal: and sent them with this letter The apostles and the elders your brothers To the brothers among the Gentiles in Antioch Syria and Cilicia Greetings
verses.literalPt: enviando, por mão deles, a seguinte carta: Os apóstolos e os presbíteros, irmãos, aos irmãos dentre os gentios em Antioquia, na Síria e Cilícia, saúde.

verses.original: Ἐπειδὴ ἠκούσαμεν ὅτι τινὲς ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξελθόντες ἐτάραξαν ὑμᾶς λόγοις ἀνασκευάζοντες τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν οἷς οὐ διεστειλάμεθα
verses.transliteration: Epeidē ēkousamen hoti tines ex hēmōn exelthontes etaraxan hymas logois anaskeuazontes tas psychas hymōn hois ou diesteilametha
verses.literal: It has come to our attention . . . that some went out from us without our authorization and unsettled you troubling your minds by what they said
verses.literalPt: Visto que soubemos que alguns dentre nós, aos quais não demos mandamento, vos tem perturbado com palavras, subvertendo as vossas almas,

verses.original: ἔδοξεν ἡμῖν γενομένοις ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐκλεξαμένοις ἄνδρας πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς σὺν τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς ἡμῶν Βαρνάβᾳ καὶ Παύλῳ
verses.transliteration: edoxen hēmin genomenois homothymadon eklexamenois andras pempsai pros hymas syn tois agapētois hēmōn Barnaba kai Paulō
verses.literal: So we all agreed . . . . . . . . . to choose men to send to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul
verses.literalPt: pareceu-nos bem, chegados a um acordo, escolher homens e enviá-los a vós com os nossos amados Barnabé e Paulo,

verses.original: ἀνθρώποις παραδεδωκόσι τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: anthrōpois paradedōkosi tas psychas autōn hyper tou onomatos tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: que têm exposto as suas vidas pelo nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: ἀπεστάλκαμεν οὖν Ἰούδαν καὶ Σιλᾶν καὶ αὐτοὺς διὰ λόγου ἀπαγγέλλοντας τὰ αὐτά
verses.transliteration: apestalkamen oun Ioudan kai Silan kai autous dia logou apangellontas ta auta
verses.literal: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas - to tell you in person the same things we are writing
verses.literalPt: Enviamos, pois, Judas e Silas, que também, por palavras, dirão as mesmas coisas.

verses.original: Ἔδοξεν γὰρ τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν μηδὲν πλέον ἐπιτίθεσθαι ὑμῖν βάρος πλὴν τούτων τῶν ἐπάναγκες
verses.transliteration: Edoxen gar tō Pneumati tō Hagiō kai hēmin mēden pleon epitithesthai hymin baros plēn toutōn tōn epanankes
verses.literal: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond . . . these essential requirements
verses.literalPt: Pois pareceu bem ao Espírito Santo e a nós não vos impor maior peso além destas coisas necessárias:

verses.original: ἀπέχεσθαι εἰδωλοθύτων καὶ αἵματος καὶ πνικτῶν καὶ πορνείας ἐξ ὧν διατηροῦντες ἑαυτοὺς εὖ πράξετε Ἔρρωσθε
verses.transliteration: apechesthai eidōlothytōn kai haimatos kai pniktōn kai porneias ex hōn diatērountes heautous eu praxete Errōsthe
verses.literal: You must abstain from food sacrificed to idols from blood from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality You will do well to avoid . . . . . . these things Farewell
verses.literalPt: que vos abstenhais de coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, de sangue, de animais sufocados e de fornicação; dessas coisas fareis bem de vos guardar. Saúde.

verses.original: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀπολυθέντες κατῆλθον εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν καὶ συναγαγόντες τὸ πλῆθος ἐπέδωκαν τὴν ἐπιστολήν
verses.transliteration: Hoi men oun apolythentes katēlthon eis Antiocheian kai synagagontes to plēthos epedōkan tēn epistolēn
verses.literal: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter
verses.literalPt: Despedidos eles, desceram a Antioquia e, tendo reunido a congregação, entregaram a carta.

verses.original: ἀναγνόντες δὲ ἐχάρησαν ἐπὶ τῇ παρακλήσει
verses.transliteration: anagnontes de echarēsan epi tē paraklēsei
verses.literal: When the people read it they rejoiced at its encouraging message
verses.literalPt: A congregação, tendo-a lido, regozijou-se pelo conforto que lhe trouxe.

verses.original: Ἰούδας τε καὶ Σιλᾶς καὶ αὐτοὶ προφῆται ὄντες διὰ λόγου πολλοῦ παρεκάλεσαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἐπεστήριξαν
verses.transliteration: Ioudas te kai Silas kai autoi prophētai ontes dia logou pollou parekalesan tous adelphous kai epestērixan
verses.literal: Judas and Silas who themselves were prophets said much . . . . . . to encourage and strengthen the brothers
verses.literalPt: Judas e Silas, que eram também profetas, consolaram os irmãos com muitas palavras e os fortaleceram.

verses.original: ποιήσαντες δὲ χρόνον ἀπελύθησαν μετ’ εἰρήνης ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστείλαντας αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: poiēsantes de chronon apelythēsan met’ eirēnēs apo tōn adelphōn pros tous aposteilantas autous
verses.literal: After spending some time there they were sent off by the brothers in peace to return to those who had sent them
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se demorado ali por algum tempo, foram pelos irmãos despedidos em paz aos que os tinham enviado.
[Mas pareceu bem a Silas ficar ali.]

verses.original: Παῦλος δὲ καὶ Βαρνάβας διέτριβον ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι μετὰ καὶ ἑτέρων πολλῶν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Paulos de kai Barnabas dietribon en Antiocheia didaskontes kai euangelizomenoi meta kai heterōn pollōn ton logon tou Kyriou
verses.literal: But Paul and Barnabas remained at Antioch along with . . . many others teaching and preaching the word of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Mas Paulo e Barnabé demoraram-se em Antioquia, ensinando e pregando com muitos outros a palavra do Senhor.

verses.original: Μετὰ δέ τινας ἡμέρας εἶπεν πρὸς Βαρνάβαν Παῦλος Ἐπιστρέψαντες δὴ ἐπισκεψώμεθα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς κατὰ πόλιν πᾶσαν ἐν αἷς κατηγγείλαμεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου πῶς ἔχουσιν
verses.transliteration: Meta de tinas hēmeras eipen pros Barnaban Paulos Epistrepsantes dē episkepsōmetha tous adelphous kata polin pasan en hais katēngeilamen ton logon tou Kyriou pōs echousin
verses.literal: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord to see how they are doing
verses.literalPt: Alguns dias depois, disse Paulo a Barnabé: Voltemos agora para visitar os irmãos por todas as cidades em que temos anunciado a palavra do Senhor, para ver como passam.

verses.original: Βαρνάβας δὲ ἐβούλετο συμπαραλαβεῖν καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην τὸν καλούμενον Μάρκον
verses.transliteration: Barnabas de ebouleto symparalabein kai ton Iōannēn ton kaloumenon Markon
verses.literal: Barnabas wanted to take - John also called Mark
verses.literalPt: Barnabé queria levar consigo também João, que tinha por sobrenome Marcos.

verses.original: Παῦλος δὲ ἠξίου τὸν ἀποστάντα ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Παμφυλίας καὶ μὴ συνελθόντα αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἔργον μὴ συμπαραλαμβάνειν τοῦτον
verses.transliteration: Paulos de ēxiou ton apostanta ap’ autōn apo Pamphylias kai mē synelthonta autois eis to ergon mē symparalambanein touton
verses.literal: But Paul thought it best not to take him because he had deserted . . . them in Pamphylia and had not accompanied them in the work
verses.literalPt: Mas Paulo não achou justo levar consigo a quem os tinha deixado desde a Panfília e que não os tinha acompanhado no trabalho.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ παροξυσμός ὥστε ἀποχωρισθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων τόν τε Βαρνάβαν παραλαβόντα τὸν Μάρκον ἐκπλεῦσαι εἰς Κύπρον
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de paroxysmos hōste apochōristhēnai autous ap’ allēlōn ton te Barnaban paralabonta ton Markon ekpleusai eis Kypron
verses.literal: Their disagreement was so sharp . . . that they parted company - Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus
verses.literalPt: Houve tal desavença, que se separaram um do outro, e Barnabé, levando consigo a Marcos, navegou para Chipre.

verses.original: Παῦλος δὲ ἐπιλεξάμενος Σιλᾶν ἐξῆλθεν παραδοθεὶς τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Κυρίου ὑπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν
verses.transliteration: Paulos de epilexamenos Silan exēlthen paradotheis tē chariti tou Kyriou hypo tōn adelphōn
verses.literal: but Paul chose Silas and left commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Mas Paulo, tendo escolhido a Silas, partiu, encomendado pelos irmãos à graça do Senhor.

verses.original: διήρχετο δὲ τὴν Συρίαν καὶ τὴν Κιλικίαν ἐπιστηρίζων τὰς ἐκκλησίας
verses.transliteration: diērcheto de tēn Syrian kai tēn Kilikian epistērizōn tas ekklēsias
verses.literal: And he traveled through Syria and Cilicia strengthening the churches
verses.literalPt: Ele passou pela Síria e Cilícia, fortalecendo as igrejas.
